This 5 ft fibre-optic Christmas tree combines 180 green branch tips with optical-fibre lighting and 21 warm white star LED lights. The star-light count includes three additional star ornaments. The tree is supplied as a single section and measures 150 cm high.

5058194831936.sourceDescription:
Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green and white finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Metal. Colour: Green and White. Stated size: 90 cm. Product weight: 2 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Compact 90 cm artificial Christmas tree ideal for small spaces and tabletop displays.
Features a festive green and white colour scheme with decorative detail for seasonal styling.
Constructed from durable plastic and metal materials for long-lasting holiday use.
Easy to arrange and store, allowing flexible placement within your Christmas display.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Table top
Assembly required
Without stand

7419042647136.sourceDescription:
This Grand Fir Christmas tree features a classic conical silhouette with 1,253 branch tips, combining pointed and rounded needle shapes for a natural, textured look that mimics a real forest pine. Standing on a sturdy 32mm steel trunk with a 50cm five-leg metal base, it stays solid and secure even when fully decorated. The 3-section plug-in design allows for tool-free assembly, and the branches fold flat for compact storage after the season. Perfect for living rooms, festive gatherings, or as a striking centrepiece in shop windows and office receptions – this tree brings a rich, full, and timeless Christmas presence to any indoor space.
Classic Grand Fir Shape: Inspired by the majestic Grand Fir, a species known for its long, glossy needles and classic conical silhouette. Unlike trendy sculpted trees, this one delivers the traditional Christmas tree look that never goes out of style.
Two Needle Types: Most artificial trees use one type of needle. We use two needle types. The pointed tips mimic the sharp outer needles of a wild pine, while the rounded tips copy the softer, fuller needles found deeper inside. This mix creates a richer, more textured look that captures the true character of a real Grand Fir, not a cheap, one-dimensional copy.
The Densest Tree: With 1,253 branch tips, this tree leaves zero gaps. More tips mean more places to hang your favourite ornaments, more volume, and a more luxurious presence that fills your entire living room corner. It's the kind of tree that creates a stunning festive atmosphere.
Heavy-Duty Steel Stand: Built with a 32mm thick steel centre pole and a 50cm 5-leg metal base, this tree stands firm even when fully loaded with decorations.
Effortless Assembly and Storage: This tree features a clever 3-section, plug-in design – simply stack the three pre-labelled sections (bottom, middle, top) one by one, no tools required. When the festive season ends, the sections pull apart easily, taking up minimal space in storage. Ready to use again for many Christmases to come.
Guarantee - 1 year

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Includes a hanging cord for easy attachment and visible display among branches.
Designed to create a focal point within coordinated seasonal arrangements.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

5056797097636.sourceDescription:
Bring a classic festive silhouette to your garden with this 1.5m 3D LED Christmas tree from MySmartBuy. Its full cone shape is outlined in 240 warm white LEDs on a durable black frame, giving a bright, welcoming glow that can be seen from the street. At 1.5m tall it makes a great centrepiece for front lawns, flower beds and borders, or a matching pair either side of the front door or garden gate. Use one as a centrepiece, place a pair either side of a doorway, or combine different sizes to create a glowing forest effect in the garden or a large room. A show-stopping alternative to a traditional tree, it brings instant festive impact with none of the needles, and can be enjoyed year after year. Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.
